// diagnostic

E2804

Two routes both match `{method} {pattern}`.

What

Two routes both match `{method} {pattern}`.

Why

A duplicate route makes dispatch ambiguous — one handler would never be reached. Registered at start-up so the bug surfaces immediately.

Fix

Remove one of the duplicate registrations, or make the patterns distinct (e.g. add a static prefix to one).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2804: tests/ui/http_route_mixed_duplicate.stderr.

Error [jet.AmbiguousRoute]: Two routes both match `GET /jokes/:id`.
  --> http_route_mixed_duplicate.jet:13:9
    |
 13 |     mux.get("/jokes/:id", (id: Int) -> Ok(server.response(200, "duplicate={id}")))
    |         ^^^
 Why: A duplicate route makes dispatch ambiguous; mounted and value routes share one ordered list
 Fix: Remove one registration or use a distinct method and path
